support.privacy.accountEmail: • If you choose to create an account, your email is used for sign-in and account recovery.
support.privacy.deviceId: • Reports and anonymous RadarPoints are linked to a device ID to reduce spam and keep points associated with this device
support.privacy.location: • While PickupRadar is open, location is used to show nearby pickup points. When you submit a wait report, your location is sent to verify that you are within {distance} of the pickup point. Those coordinates are not stored, and PickupRadar does not use background location tracking.
support.privacy.locationOfflineQueue: • While PickupRadar is open, location is used to show nearby pickup points. You can also browse without location. For live wait and venue-status reports, your location is used to verify you are within {distance} of the pickup point. Coordinates used for this check are not saved with wait-report records. If a wait report cannot be sent immediately, it may be saved on your phone with its coordinates for retrying. Queued reports older than 15 minutes are not sent, and the saved report and its coordinates are removed when PickupRadar next checks the queue. PickupRadar does not track your location in the background.
support.privacy.noLogin: • No login is required to use PickupRadar or earn RadarPoints
support.privacy.radarProfile: • PickupRadar creates an anonymous Radar profile to track RadarPoints. Creating an account is optional and helps protect and recover your points.
support.privacy.reportData: • Wait reports may include venue, platform, wait time, whether the venue starts preparing the order on arrival, and time submitted
support.privacy.title: Privacy summary
